messages:
sara: FYI running the python sampleapp batching helper (embeddings -> rerank) hit a 400. Error says: embedding dimension 1536 != model dimension 1024.
mike: which model and sampleapp version? can you paste the short payload and error?
sara: sampleapp v0.3.2, model=openembed-1024. Payload (trimmed):
```
POST /v1/embeddings
{
  "model": "openembed-1024",
  "input": ["p1","p2"]
}
```
Error: `400 Bad Request: embedding dimension 1536 != model dimension 1024`.
abby: sounds like an old node cache got read by python. Node used `vectors` key and a 1536 model historically. Does the helper merge cached vectors?
sara: yes we merge local cache entries with fresh batch outputs. I inspected the merged list and one vector length is 1536.
nina: also saw a retry/auth wrinkle: if token expires mid-batch the retry replays the same request but does not refresh Authorization header, so first retry returns 401 then the subsequent flow shows mixed-dim errors. log example: `HTTP 401 Token expired -> retrying batch -> HTTP 400 embedding dimension mismatch`.
mike: plan: 1) validate cache entries on load and drop mismatched dims (log key & reason); 2) normalize cache keys (`vectors` -> `embedding`) on read; 3) ensure retry refreshes token before replaying batch.
sara: I'll open a small PR with those three changes and add a unit test that creates a fake cache entry with 1536 dims to assert it's dropped.
abby: I'll add an integration test to simulate token expiry mid-batch and assert auth.refresh happens before retry. Also add a short doc blurb in SDK parity notes about `vectors` vs `embedding` and model-id drift.
ci-bot: CI queued: sampleapp/patch-embed-cache-validation -> staging
mike: after staging deploy run devex/regress-embed-parity job across archived caches.
sara: posting repro for tests: create a cache file containing one 1536-length float array, then run the batching helper against openembed-1024 and expect the loader to drop the bad cache entry and proceed.
abby: thanks, please link the PR and I'll run the regression job when ready. :thumbsup:
